items.caseName: Martanda Singh v. State of Chhattisgarh & Anr.
items.coram: J.B. Pardiwala, K. Vinod Chandran, JJ.
items.headline: Long consensual relationship isn't rape by false promise
items.text: Rape case quashed: a three-year consensual relationship doesn't show consent was obtained by a false promise of marriage.

items.caseName: Additional Commissioner, Commercial Tax v. Cadila Health Care Ltd.
items.headline: Tax goods by their form at sale, not end use
items.text: Powders and biscuits can't be taxed as beverages just because buyers may mix them with milk or water.

items.caseName: Rakesh Kumar Singh v. Union of India
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI; Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: No ex parte suspension of CEC; ECI must respond
items.text: Plea to suspend CEC Gyanesh Kumar refused for now; notice issued to the Centre and ECI on claims of unilateral decisions.

items.caseName: Union of India v. Meena Gupta & Ors.
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI; Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: Great Nicobar PILs to go on in Calcutta HC
items.text: Centre's challenge to PIL maintainability rejected; Calcutta HC to hear the petitions on 25–26 November.

items.caseName: Ashish Mishra @ Monu v. State of U.P.
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI; Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: Lakhimpur Kheri: trial judge report sent to HC Chief Justice
items.text: Vigilance report on the trial judge sent to the Allahabad HC Chief Justice; UP to appoint a new special prosecutor.

items.caseName: Association of Retired Judges of Supreme Court and High Courts of India v. NHRC & Ors.
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI; Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: Notice on vacant State Human Rights Commissions
items.text: Notice issued on a PIL to fill vacancies in State Human Rights Commissions within a fixed time.

items.caseName: In Re: Recent Rape Incidents in Delhi NCR
items.coram: J.B. Pardiwala, K. Vinod Chandran, JJ.
items.headline: Safety audits ordered across Delhi-NCR
items.text: Police told to run safety audits, map high-risk zones and monitor CCTV live; compliance due by 16 November.

items.caseName: In Re: 135-Year-Old Library, 8.5 Lakh Books and No Room in the New Central Vista Plan
items.headline: Centre must show space for 135-year-old library
items.text: Centre to file an affidavit with layout plans for the library's new space; Haripriya Padmanabhan made amicus.

items.caseName: In Re: Fundamental Right to Walk and Footpath v. Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
items.headline: Centre to name an authority for footpaths on every road
items.text: Centre to identify a funded authority to ensure footpaths, pick five pilot towns and report in three weeks.

items.caseName: State of Tamil Nadu v. Vignesh
items.headline: NDPS bail for unsupplied arrest grounds: order reserved
items.text: Verdict reserved on whether bail can follow failure to give arrest grounds even when Section 37 NDPS bars aren't met.

items.caseName: Rajpal Naurang Yadav & Anr. v. M/s Murli Projects Pvt. Ltd.
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI; Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: Actor Rajpal Yadav told to deposit ₹5 crore
items.text: Rebuked for not depositing ₹5 crore in cheque cases; told to pay by 6 Oct, matter listed first on 7 Oct.

items.caseName: Shanawaz Khan & 5 Ors. v. State of U.P. & 4 Ors.
items.headline: Don't stop five-time azan if noise rules are kept
items.text: Police told not to interfere with azan at a Saharanpur mosque if noise rules are followed, on an undertaking.

items.caseName: Moti Ram Jaat @ Moti Ram Jaat Fauji v. State of U.P. & Anr.
items.headline: Arrest in a second case is a fresh arrest
items.text: Grounds must be given under Art. 22(1) for a new case, but that plea can be raised only up to the remand stage.

items.caseName: Fanindra Das v. The General Manager & Anr.
items.headline: Railways can't refuse power citing private land
items.text: Where only the Railways can supply power, it must give the connection within 30 days; electricity is part of Art. 21.

items.caseName: National Insurance Co. Ltd. v. Reeta & 4 Ors.
items.headline: Accident payout raised on insurer's own appeal
items.text: Once an insurer disputes the amount, the court must ensure just compensation, even without a cross-appeal.

items.caseName: Sagar Gawai & Anr. v. Election Commission of India & Ors.
items.coram: Mahesh Chandra Tripathi, CJ; Advait Sethna, J.
items.headline: No stay on Maharashtra SIR voter deletions
items.text: Stay refused as the Supreme Court is hearing SIR challenges; matter deferred by three weeks.

items.caseName: Raj Kumar Jaiswal v. State of West Bengal & Anr.
items.headline: Obscene gesture and remark outraged modesty
items.text: Six-month jail under Section 509 IPC upheld; the woman's testimony was found credible.

items.caseName: Shaikh Mujtaba Farooq & Ors. v. Union of India & Ors.
items.headline: No independent probe into 2020 riots, Jamia violence
items.text: Pleas for an independent probe and FIRs against politicians dismissed; no material showed police compromised the probe.

items.caseName: ANI Media Pvt. Ltd. v. RSY News
items.headline: Copying whole news videos isn't fair dealing
items.text: Summary judgment for ANI: RSY News barred from using its videos and told to take down infringing content.

items.caseName: Imrat Singh v. Chimna
items.headline: Elderly men may rely on a younger woman for litigation
items.text: Refusal to condone delay set aside; assuming a woman can't handle family litigation was called gender-biased.

items.caseName: Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam v. CTR Nirmal Kumar & Ors.
items.headline: DMK may sue TN ministers for defamation
items.text: Leave granted to sue over remarks in the Veeramani POCSO case; they were personal remarks, not official acts.

items.caseName: G v. A
items.headline: Woman misled about husband's divorce gets maintenance
items.text: Strict proof of marriage isn't needed under Section 125 CrPC where the couple lived together long-term.

items.caseName: V. Thangavel v. The Inspector of Police
items.headline: Make attachment mandatory in graft cases, says HC
items.text: Confiscation order set aside for want of attachment; the Court urged a law making attachment mandatory.

items.caseName: Tata Steel v. State Pollution Control Board
items.headline: Pollution case against Tata Steel quashed
items.text: Section 32A IBC shields Tata Steel from liability for Bhushan Steel's old management's acts.

items.caseName: Case title not yet reported
items.coram: Ashwani Kumar Mishra, CJ; Rohit Kapoor, J.
items.headline: CBI to probe graft claims against CM's aide
items.text: CBI told to register a case on ED's referral against CM Bhagwant Mann's OSD; State must assist.

items.caseName: Case title not yet reported
items.coram: Ashwani Kumar Mishra, CJ; Rohit Kapoor, J.
items.headline: Demolition against whistleblower lawyer goes to CBI
items.text: Demolition of a lawyer's farm stay soon after he flagged corruption showed apparent malice; CBI to probe.

items.caseName: Muslim Khan v. National Investigation Agency
items.coram: Sanjay K. Agrawal, CJ; Sameer Jain, J.
items.headline: No bail for five in Kanhaiya Lal murder case
items.text: UAPA bail appeals dismissed; the terror act was said to strike at the nation's 'psychological sovereignty'.

items.caseName: Mahesh Kumar Gupta & Ors. v. State of Rajasthan
items.headline: Accused parents may fly abroad for son's surgery
items.text: Travel to the US allowed despite a pending probe; a parent's care isn't limited to hospitalisation.

items.caseName: S.Q. Masood & Anr. v. Election Commission of India & Ors.
items.coram: P. Sam Koshy, Narsing Rao Nandikonda, JJ.
items.headline: ECI must explain voter's exclusion without notice
items.text: ECI asked why a voter was dropped in the AI-based SIR without notice; listed on 13 October.

items.court: Patiala House Courts, New Delhi, Delhi
items.caseName: Case title not yet reported
items.headline: Bail for 17 students, journalists after CEC protest
items.text: Bail on ₹15,000 bonds; the court noted they are young first-time accused, though the allegations were serious.

highlights.caseName: Suo motu case (title not yet reported)
highlights.text: SC takes up plan to cram a 135-year-old library into two rooms.

items.caseName: Prabha Devi v. State of Bihar & Ors.
items.coram: Satish Chandra Sharma, N.K. Singh, JJ.
items.headline: Not stopping a son isn't cruelty by mother-in-law
items.text: Case against a mother-in-law quashed; vague claims of taunts or failing to restrain her son don't make out Section 498A.

items.caseName: Case title not yet reported
items.coram: P.V. Sanjay Kumar, Sanjeev Sachdeva, JJ.
items.headline: Suo motu case on moving 135-year-old library
items.text: SC took up on its own the plan to shift the Central Secretariat Library's 8.5 lakh volumes into two rooms; listed for 5 Oct.

items.caseName: Pooja Devi v. State of U.P. and 3 Others
items.coram: Ajay Bhanot, Divesh Chandra Samant, JJ.
items.headline: DM must refer Gangsters Act property plea to court
items.text: A DM who rejects a plea to release attached property must refer it to court under Section 16(1); the order was quashed.

items.caseName: X v. State of Andhra Pradesh & Others
items.headline: No trial of NRI in-laws without Centre's sanction
items.text: Cruelty case against NRI relatives quashed: acts abroad needed Section 188 CrPC sanction and Indian allegations were vague.

items.caseName: X v. State & Anr.
items.headline: Retaliatory 498A case against husband quashed
items.text: No specific overt acts were alleged, and the complaint followed her kin's conviction for assaulting the husband's family.

items.caseName: B Vijaya Sai v. State of Andhra Pradesh & Another
items.headline: NBWs need reasons, not routine issue
items.text: Non-bailable warrant against a 70-year-old in a cheque case recalled; courts must record reasons before coercive steps.

items.caseName: Harbinder Singh Kalsi & Anr. v. State of Assam & Ors.
items.coram: Ashutosh Kumar, CJ; Arun Dev Choudhury, J.
items.headline: Lawyers aren't guarantors of a client's whereabouts
items.text: Costs of ₹50,000 and a Bar Council referral against advocates set aside; they must still verify a vakalatnama is genuine.

items.caseName: X & Anr. v. Kochi Municipal Corporation
items.headline: Fix father's name without DNA test if paternity undisputed
items.text: Birth record correction ordered for the child's sake; the Court asked the legislature to rethink the DNA test rule.

items.caseName: Parteek Goel v. State of Haryana and Another
items.headline: Bail plea can't wait on an unstayed transfer petition
items.text: Trial courts must decide bail and not keep adjourning it just because a transfer plea is pending in the High Court without a stay.

items.caseName: State of Himachal Pradesh v. Anchla @ Chanchla
items.headline: IO must collect evidence, not create it
items.text: Acquittal in a double murder upheld; a DNA match showed presence at some time, not on the day of the crime.

items.caseName: Central Bureau of Investigation v. Anil Dixit
items.coram: J.B. Pardiwala, K. Vinod Chandran, JJ.
items.headline: Accused may seek 'unrelied' documents
items.text: An accused is entitled to documents held by the prosecution for the defence, with timing managed by the court.

items.caseName: Kalawati Devi v. State of U.P.
items.headline: No habeas corpus to force adult daughter home
items.text: Parents cannot use habeas corpus to make an adult daughter live with them when she is not illegally detained.

items.caseName: Bhavna Yadav v. State of U.P.
items.headline: Meritorious reserved candidates go to open list early
items.text: Reserved candidates above the general cut-off must be counted as unreserved at screening, not only at final selection.

items.caseName: Case title not yet reported
items.headline: Action against advocate who solemnised child marriage
items.text: Calling it disgraceful, the Court ordered prosecution of the advocate and asked the Bar Council to act on his licence.

items.caseName: A v. State
items.headline: Later marriage can't legalise sex with a minor
items.text: Under POCSO, marrying after both become adults does not cure intercourse that happened when the girl was a minor.

items.caseName: Himanshu v. State (GNCT of Delhi)
items.headline: Digital arrest scams: trace the money mules
items.text: Tracking those who receive and move the money is as important as finding the callers.

items.caseName: Dr. Rita Bakshi v. Seema Bajaj
items.headline: Examine complainant before hearing accused
items.text: Under Section 223 BNSS, the Magistrate must first record the complainant and witnesses on oath.

items.caseName: State v. Om Parkash @ Kallu
items.headline: Section 164 statement can't replace testimony
items.text: An acquittal was upheld while the Court noted how society blames rape survivors.

items.caseName: Aditya Vikram Bohra v. State (NCT of Delhi)
items.headline: Stray dogs: authorities faulted
items.text: The Court said people suffer because authorities have not implemented Supreme Court directions on stray dogs.

items.caseName: Amrita M. v. State of Karnataka
items.headline: Body-shaming alone isn't insulting modesty
items.text: Verbal remarks on a woman's looks, without more, do not make out the offence under Section 509 IPC.

items.caseName: Praveen Sodharan v. State of Kerala
items.headline: Brothel case can't be quashed for lack of victim grievance
items.text: Offences under the Immoral Traffic Act concern the public; charges against some accused were partly quashed.

items.caseName: A v. S
items.headline: Childlessness is not cruelty
items.text: Marriage is not only for procreation; a husband's divorce plea on that ground was rejected.

items.caseName: Ram Niwas Sharma v. Rekha Gupta
items.court: Rouse Avenue Court, New Delhi, Delhi
items.headline: Police report sought on plea for FIR against Delhi CM
items.text: Status report due by 15 October on a complaint over the CM's remark comparing officials to Lord Hanuman.

items.caseName: Saurabh Bajaj v. State of Chhattisgarh
items.coram: J.B. Pardiwala, K. Vinod Chandran, JJ.
items.headline: No presumption of slaughter from missing papers
items.text: Conviction under the cattle preservation law set aside; absence of documents alone doesn't show cattle were for slaughter.

items.caseName: State of Maharashtra v. Ramesh Sukrya Mhatre
items.headline: Bail of corporator who assaulted doctors cancelled
items.text: Attacks on doctors can't be tolerated; the accused must surrender and an elected mandate is no licence for violence.

items.caseName: Union of India v. Jitendra Verma
items.headline: Grandson can be a 'near relative' for compassionate job
items.text: The Court refused to interfere with the HC order asking Railways to reconsider a deceased employee's grandson.

items.caseName: S. Rajaseekaran v. Union of India
items.headline: Yamuna Expressway bus fire: report sought
items.text: The Centre and UP must report on arrests of the driver and owner and on the bus's safety compliance.

items.caseName: Amit Ghosh v. State of West Bengal
items.coram: J.B. Pardiwala, K. Vinod Chandran, JJ.
items.headline: Trial judge's 'advice' on bail disapproved
items.text: It is not for a presiding officer to advise on bail; the Registry will seek an explanation from the judge.

items.caseName: Kamalabai v. Shivappa @ Shivayogi
items.coram: Augustine George Masih, R. Mahadevan, JJ.
items.headline: Devadasi practice: Karnataka told to give rehab details
items.text: After the State said dedications no longer happen, it was asked for more on rehabilitation; listed after four weeks.

items.caseName: Jaysheel Tiwari v. Union of India
items.headline: Jaunpur custodial death: bail denied to 4 policemen
items.text: Noting grave CBI allegations of torture to extract confessions, the Court refused bail.

items.caseName: Devendra Singh v. Great Home Developers Pvt. Ltd.
items.headline: Unpaid price doesn't void a registered sale deed
items.text: The seller's remedy is a suit to recover the money, not cancellation of the deed.

items.caseName: Akhilesh Jaiswal v. Bar Council of India
items.coram: Shekhar B. Saraf, Abdhesh Kumar Chaudhary, JJ.
items.headline: No licence suspension at interim stage
items.text: A Bar Council cannot suspend an advocate's licence midway through a disciplinary inquiry.

items.caseName: Ashi Agarwal v. Union of India
items.headline: Sympathy can't relax IIT eligibility
items.text: A JEE aspirant's plea was rejected; hardship is no ground to depart from admission criteria.

items.caseName: Dr. Bhimashankar Bilgundi v. Directorate of Enforcement
items.headline: ED attachment: writ maintainable but discretionary
items.text: Article 226 lies against ED attachment, but the Court may send the party to the PMLA appeal remedy.

items.caseName: Seva Trust v. Additional Chief Secretary
items.coram: S.A. Dharmadhikari, CJ., G. Arul Murugan, J.
items.headline: SOP for captive elephants at temple festivals
items.text: The State must frame rules with mandatory health, safety and veterinary checks for elephants used in festivals.

items.caseName: Dr. E. Subaya @ Esakki Subaya v. Kanthimathinathan
items.caseNo: OA No. 866 of 2026 in ELP No. 2 of 2026
items.headline: Election petition against ex-MLA to go to trial
items.text: The plea to reject it failed, but the prayer to declare the runner-up elected was struck off.

items.caseName: Dalbeer Singh v. State of Rajasthan
items.coram: Sanjay K. Agarwal, CJ., Inderjeet Singh, J.
items.headline: Back wages for employee sacked after acquittal
items.text: An employee terminated after his acquittal is owed back wages until reinstatement.

items.caseName: Vijay Gopal v. N.V. Ramana Goud
items.headline: Strikes can't stop lawyers attending court
items.text: A one-day strike may be allowed rarely, but Bar associations cannot obstruct or assault advocates who appear.

items.caseName: Sainaba v. State of Kerala
items.headline: Cheque-bounce notice valid even if mother received it
items.text: Notice sent to the drawer's correct address is served even when a family member takes it; Section 138 conviction restored.

items.caseName: Surinder Ahuja v. State of Punjab
items.headline: Severance compensation must reflect lost utility

items.caseName: Sterling Holiday Resorts Ltd. v. M/s P.M. Associates
items.headline: SARFAESI sale to a non-existent bidder set aside
items.text: Bids taken in breach of a restraint order, and a sale certificate to a firm formed later, cannot support a valid auction.

items.caseName: Santosh Gurung v. State of Sikkim
items.coram: Ujjal Bhuyan, Atul S. Chandurkar, JJ.
items.headline: Section 313 answers can't fill gaps in the chain
items.text: Acquitting in a child rape-murder case, the Court said the accused's statement cannot complete unproved circumstantial evidence.

items.caseName: Mihira Sood v. Bar Council of India
items.headline: Bar Councils have no disciplinary power over law students
items.text: The BCI Chairman's directions against NALSAR were declared bad in law.

items.caseName: Seema Joshi v. Bar Council of India
items.headline: Frame rules on harassment complaints by women lawyers
items.text: The Court asked the Centre and the BCI to frame regulations for sexual harassment complaints by women advocates in all courts.

items.caseName: S. Rajaseekaran v. Union of India
items.headline: Impound vehicles with unpaid e-challans
items.text: Noting about Rs 23,000 crore in pending fines, the Court ordered impounding and a freeze of online vehicle services until dues are paid.

items.caseName: Ahmed Bawa @ Abbu Abubakar Barelvi v. State of Gujarat
items.coram: Vikram Nath, Augustine George Masih, Sandeep Mehta, JJ.
items.headline: Death sentence in 2008 Ahmedabad blasts case stayed
items.text: The Court stayed the execution, issued notice to Gujarat and called for the trial records.

items.caseName: All India Trinamool Congress v. State of West Bengal
items.coram: M.M. Sundresh, Prasanna B. Varale, JJ.
items.headline: No unfreezing of AITC accounts for poll expenses
items.text: The Court said the party's entitlement to the assets must be decided first and refused to release funds.

items.caseName: Case title not yet reported
items.headline: SIT probe into KPSC recruitment stayed
items.text: On Karnataka's appeal, the Court stayed the High Court's SIT direction and let the State object to its members.

items.caseName: Case title not yet reported
items.headline: Bengal asked to reply to Mahua Moitra's eviction plea
items.text: The State must respond within a week to the MP's claim that officials evicted her from a circuit house room in Nadia.

items.caseName: Samantha Ruth Prabhu v. John Does
items.headline: Actor's personality rights protected
items.text: Platforms told to take down morphed and deepfake content of the actor and act with due diligence.

items.caseName: Suryakant Gulabrao Yewale v. State of Maharashtra
items.headline: Govt land sale probe: DGP to monitor
items.text: Granting anticipatory bail to a Tehsildar, the Court asked why the firm's 99% stakeholder Parth Pawar was not named.

items.caseName: Rani Pratap Singh v. State of Maharashtra
items.headline: Victim's immigrant status no defence to trafficking
items.text: The brothel owner's conviction was upheld; blaming an undocumented victim was called victim-shaming.

items.caseName: Paresh Salgaonkar v. State of Goa
items.headline: Goa SIR: ECI questioned on automatic Form 8 rejections
items.text: The Goa bench asked why rejected applicants have no remedy against automated rejection of address-change forms.

items.caseName: X v. Y
items.headline: Bank transactions are not 'disposable income'
items.text: Maintenance needs a full look at both parties' means, not just entries in the husband's bank account.

items.caseName: Raju Kumar Singh v. State
items.headline: No stay on MLA's conviction in firing case
items.text: The Court refused to suspend the Bihar MLA's conviction for a fatal 2018 celebratory firing, citing moral turpitude.

items.caseName: Priyank M. Kharge v. Tejas A
items.headline: RSS defamation: Kharge, Nalapad sent to Sessions Court
items.text: The Court declined to entertain the petitions and told the leaders to file revisions before the Sessions Court.

items.caseName: State of Karnataka v. Vemanna G.
items.coram: D.K. Singh, H. Shanthi Bhushan, JJ.
items.headline: Ex-serviceman gets only a site, not 5 acres
items.text: Under the amended rule only a residential site is allowed when no farm land is free; the Court regretted the outcome.

items.caseName: Dinesh Menon v. State of Kerala
items.headline: Speaker to act on MLA Mani C. Kappan's disqualification
items.text: After his conviction in cheque-bounce cases, the Speaker was asked to take steps in accordance with law.

items.caseName: S v. A
items.headline: No routine DNA test of a child
items.text: A DNA test needs prima facie proof that the spouses had no access; Section 112 presumes legitimacy.

items.caseName: Jaseela C. v. State of Kerala
items.headline: Trial against IAS officer Sriram Venkitaraman stayed
items.text: The 2019 rash-driving trial is stayed while the State reconsiders the widow's request for a special prosecutor.

items.caseName: State of Tamil Nadu v. Secretary, St. Joseph's College
items.headline: Minority institutions may fill sanctioned posts
items.text: Aided minority institutions can appoint qualified teachers to sanctioned vacancies without prior permission.

items.caseName: Enforcement Directorate v. Vasudevan Satyamurthy
items.coram: Manjunath Sangreshi, Addl. City Civil & Sessions Judge
items.headline: Ozone Group chairman sent to 14-day ED custody
items.text: The special court said custodial questioning was needed to trace about Rs 927 crore taken from homebuyers.

items.caseName: Sanjay Badaya v. State of Rajasthan
items.headline: Bail in Jal Jeevan Mission forgery case: undertrial custody is not punishment
items.text: Probe over and chargesheets filed, two accused in the Rs 979 crore PHED contracts case got bail. Pre-trial jail can't act as punishment.
items.why: Reinforces that bail cannot be denied to punish an accused before trial.

items.caseName: Arjun Gopal v. Union of India
items.coram: M.M. Sundresh, Augustine George Masih, JJ.
items.headline: No total firecracker ban, no round-the-clock bursting
items.text: The Court ruled out both extremes and accepted joint crackers with limits. Barium testing of green crackers must finish by 15 October.

items.caseName: Mahendra Singh Deo v. Govind Mohan
items.headline: Special Bench faults Registry over CAPF contempt delisting
items.text: The Registry's explanation was taken in a sealed cover. The contempt plea will be heard on 15 October with the CAPF Act challenge.

items.caseName: Veena Rani Saluja v. State of U.P.
items.headline: UP police officer summoned over 'unknown accused' FIR
items.text: The FIR named no accused though the rider was caught on the spot. The Circle Officer must appear and explain at the next hearing.

items.caseName: M.S. Raghavan v. State
items.coram: J.B. Pardiwala, K. Vinod Chandran, JJ.
items.headline: Can IPC case go on after PC Act sanction is refused?
items.text: Judgment reserved on ex-IDBI Bank officials' plea that IPC prosecution must end once sanction under the PC Act was refused on merits.

items.caseName: Raghvendra Dubey v. State of U.P.
items.headline: CCTV down? Police must log every arrest in the General Diary
items.text: Finding about 24 hours of illegal detention, the Court awarded Rs 10,000 and said missing footage can lead to an adverse inference.

items.caseName: Case title not yet reported
items.headline: Sachin Waze's bail stayed on NIA appeal
items.text: The special court's bail order in the Antilia bomb scare case was stayed. The NIA's appeal will be heard in the first week of October.

items.caseName: Umar Khalid v. State
items.coram: Prathiba M. Singh, Dinesh Bhatt, JJ.
items.headline: Umar Khalid, Sharjeel Imam denied bail in riots UAPA case
items.text: Bound by the Supreme Court's Gulfisha Fatima ruling, the bench refused bail and denied parity with co-accused whose roles differed.

items.caseName: Tahir Hussain v. State
items.headline: Tahir Hussain may use records from other riots cases
items.text: The trial court's refusal under Section 94 BNSS was set aside. He may obtain forensic data and call records, but the trial must not be delayed.

items.caseName: Bilal v. State (NCT of Delhi)
items.headline: Muslim marriage no defence under POCSO
items.text: The FIR over sex with a wife married at 16 was not quashed. Personal law gives no immunity where the spouse is under 18.

items.caseName: Ms G v. State (NCT of Delhi)
items.headline: Rape victim must be heard before bail
items.text: Victims under Section 376 IPC / 69 BNS can take part at every stage, including bail. Bail granted without hearing her was sent back.

items.caseName: DMRC v. Pankaj
items.headline: Award by DMRC's own officer-arbitrator restored
items.text: The arbitrator was appointed in March 2015, before the 2015 amendment, so the new ineligibility rules did not apply. The Rs 40 lakh award stands.

items.caseName: Meta Platforms v. Mr X
items.coram: C. Hari Shankar, Nivedita Anil Sharma, JJ.
items.headline: Right to be forgotten: Facebook need not de-index
items.text: The bench clarified that de-indexing directions on judgments do not bind Meta, as Facebook is not a search engine.

items.caseName: Vijay Shankar Meena v. University of Delhi
items.headline: NSUI candidate's DUSU poll challenge fails
items.text: Undated photos of staff celebrating ABVP wins did not prove bias, and post-result celebration is not canvassing.

items.caseName: Sachin Chaudhary v. Delhi State Legal Services Authority
items.headline: One panel, one district rule for legal aid lawyers upheld
items.text: Limiting advocates to one DLSA application was not arbitrary, and empanelment was already well advanced.

items.caseName: Shri Sanatan Dharam Ramleela Samiti v. DDA
items.headline: Ramlila can't override park's green use
items.text: DDA's cancellation of the Chintoo Park booking was upheld. Residents' need for the park outweighs brief event use.

items.caseName: Ashumal @ Asharam v. State of Gujarat
items.headline: No temporary bail for Asaram; video call allowed
items.text: Medical reports showed his wife was recovering, so there was no urgency. He may speak to her by video with jail permission.

items.caseName: Anwar Jan v. UT of J&K
items.coram: Sanjeev Kumar, Mohd Yousuf Wani, JJ.
items.headline: PSA detention for cattle smuggling quashed
items.text: Smuggling should be prosecuted, not met with preventive detention. The order ignored that he was on bail.

items.caseName: Dawood v. UT of J&K
items.headline: Sharing terror propaganda online attracts UAPA
items.text: Charges under Section 13 UAPA and 201 IPC were upheld; the Section 20 UAPA charge was set aside.

items.caseName: A v. B
items.coram: Sujit Narayan Prasad, Sanjay Prasad, JJ.
items.headline: Wife's wish for a 'gharjamai' husband is not cruelty
items.text: Dismissal of the husband's divorce petition was upheld. Wanting him to live with her parents does not amount to cruelty.

items.caseName: X v. Y
items.caseNo: Rev. Pet. Family Court No. 284 of 2025
items.headline: No limitation period for Section 125 maintenance
items.text: A plea filed 21 years after a wife was forced out was wrongly dismissed for delay. The Family Court must fix maintenance in 3 months.

items.caseName: Suraj Revanna v. State of Karnataka
items.headline: Order adding JD(S) MLC as murder-attempt accused quashed
items.text: Summoning under Section 319 CrPC 'is not a frolicsome act' and needs more than a prima facie case, which was missing here.

items.caseName: Sri Vinayaka Chitramandira v. State of Karnataka
items.headline: 2% cinema ticket cess: no coercive action, no stay
items.text: The State's assurance of no coercive action against the theatres was recorded, but the Act was not stayed. Next hearing 26 October.

items.caseName: Unaiz Kadumbottil v. Union of India
items.headline: Pakistani spouse of Indian has no vested right to a visa
items.text: Visa control is a sovereign function. The Centre's suspension of visas for Pakistani nationals was upheld.

items.caseName: MB v. State of Madhya Pradesh
items.headline: Kumbh viral star's birth date change set aside
items.text: Her date of birth was changed at her father's request without hearing her, which breached natural justice.

items.caseName: Giribala Singh v. State of Madhya Pradesh
items.headline: Twisha Sharma case: bail plea may be amended
items.text: After CBI dropped the dowry death charge, the Court let her amend her bail plea. Listed on 8 October.

items.caseName: Varaaki v. The State
items.headline: No CBI probe yet in Veeramani POCSO case
items.text: The SIT, formed four days earlier, must get time. The petitioner must hand his material to the SIT on 1 October.

items.caseName: State of Kerala v. Rose Mary
items.coram: Ash K. Bal, I Additional Sessions Judge
items.court: POCSO Special Court, Thodupuzha, Idukki, Kerala
items.headline: Life term for mother who strangled her newborn
items.text: The court found the baby was born alive and killed in 2014, and convicted the mother of murder.

highlights.text: A custodial confession alone can't justify NSA detention; Rs 10 lakh costs on UP.

highlights.caseName: Directorate of Enforcement v. Bhupesh Arora
highlights.text: Bail cancelled in Chinese app PMLA case: settling the fraud doesn't erase laundering.

highlights.caseName: Case title not yet reported
highlights.text: Hookah bars barred across UP, even in designated smoking areas.

highlights.caseName: Vipin Pandey v. Rani Durgavati University

items.caseName: Mulla Afroz v. Union of India
items.headline: NSA detention of Sambhal violence accused quashed; Rs 10 lakh costs on UP
items.text: A confession made in police custody cannot by itself support preventive detention. The NSA order was quashed with Rs 10 lakh costs on UP.
items.why: Protects the Article 22(5) safeguard against detention built on custodial statements.

items.caseName: S v. State of Odisha
items.headline: Marriage at a 'dead end' dissolved under Article 142
items.text: The Court granted divorce with Rs 35 lakh permanent alimony. It quashed 18 cases between the couple and barred fresh litigation.

items.caseName: M/s ASJ Finsolutions Pvt. Ltd. v. Vikram Bajaj
items.coram: J.B. Pardiwala, K. Vinod Chandran, JJ.
items.headline: EMD forfeited when auction terms allow it, even if IBBI rules are silent
items.text: A bidder who missed paying the Rs 19.17 crore balance lost its Rs 6.39 crore deposit. Express e-auction forfeiture terms were enforceable.

items.caseName: Bombay Garage Ahmedabad Ltd. v. J P Iscon Pvt. Ltd.
items.coram: J.B. Pardiwala, K. Vinod Chandran, JJ.
items.headline: Omitted relief stays barred despite liberty to file a fresh suit
items.text: Without leave under Order 2 Rule 2 CPC in the first suit, a later suit for specific performance is barred. Liberty under Order 23 does not cure this.

items.caseName: Megha Gaur v. State of Rajasthan
items.coram: CJI Surya Kant, Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: RCA polls go ahead, but results kept sealed
items.text: The Court refused to halt the Rajasthan Cricket Association elections but barred declaring results. The HC must quickly hear the plea on excluding women voters.

items.caseName: Dinesh Biwaji Ashtikar v. State of Maharashtra
items.headline: NCPCR chief summoned over 25% RTE quota
items.text: Faulting NCPCR's indifference to the EWS quota in private schools, the bench directed its Chairperson and Director to appear in person.

items.caseName: Sahadev Uraon v. State of Jharkhand
items.coram: M.M. Sundresh, Prasanna B. Varale, JJ.
items.headline: Bail for man jailed over posts on Kalpana Soren
items.text: After over a year in custody, with the chargesheet filed and a maximum sentence of three years, the accused was granted bail.

items.caseName: Gunjan Sinha v. Union of India
items.headline: Should patent term run from grant when grant is delayed?
items.text: Notice issued on a plea that a seven-year grant delay ate into the 20-year patent term under Section 53. An amicus will assist.

items.caseName: Directorate of Enforcement v. Bhupesh Arora
items.coram: M.M. Sundresh, Prasanna B. Varale, JJ.
items.headline: Bail cancelled in Chinese investment app PMLA case
items.text: Settling the predicate offence does not wipe out the money laundering. Arora's bail was cancelled and co-accused Rohit Vij's plea rejected.

items.caseName: Case title not yet reported
items.coram: Shekhar B. Saraf, Abdhesh Kumar Chaudhary, JJ.
items.headline: No hookah bars in UP, even in smoking zones
items.text: Hookah service is barred even in designated smoking areas. A non-smoker's right to clean air outweighs the right to trade.

items.caseName: Nirmala Devi v. State of U.P.
items.headline: Heart attack claim can't end dowry death case at the outset
items.text: Where a young wife dies within seven years amid cruelty claims, a heart attack finding does not prove a natural death at the quashing stage.

items.caseName: West Bengal Pradesh Congress Committee v. Election Commission of India
items.headline: Plea on BJP Nandigram candidate's age discrepancy dismissed
items.text: The Court rejected Congress's challenge to Hasirani Rath's affidavit, accepting that the objection was late and did not affect her eligibility.

items.caseName: Milan Pradhan v. State of West Bengal
items.headline: Interim bail lets Congress candidate contest Nandigram by-poll
items.text: Pradhan was released on interim bail till 20 October. Warrants from 2007 were executed only after he filed his nomination.

items.caseName: Directorate of Enforcement v. Greenopolis Welfare Confederation
items.headline: Ex-CJI Sanjiv Khanna to head Greenopolis homebuyers' panel
items.text: A committee will verify homebuyers' claims over ED-attached properties in the stalled Gurugram project and help restitution within eight months.

items.caseName: Red Bull v. Union of India
items.headline: FSSAI order against 'Energy Drink' label set aside
items.text: Red Bull was not heard before the order was passed. FSSAI may reconsider after giving a proper hearing.

items.caseName: Harcharan Singh Bhalla v. State (NCT of Delhi)
items.headline: No custodial interrogation just to recover stridhan
items.text: Recovering stridhan is outside the bail court's remit, so it cannot justify custody. An 80-year-old was granted anticipatory bail.

items.caseName: South Indian Bank Ltd. v. National Highways Authority of India
items.headline: Rs 1 lakh costs on lawyer who appeared from a moving car
items.text: Joining a virtual hearing from a moving vehicle breached the video-conferencing rules, so costs were imposed on counsel.

items.caseName: Arvind Kejriwal v. Gujarat University
items.coram: CJ Sunita Agarwal, D.N. Ray, J.
items.headline: Kejriwal's appeal against Rs 25,000 costs in PM degree row rejected
items.text: The Division Bench refused to disturb the costs imposed over his RTI pursuit of the Prime Minister's degree.

items.caseName: State of Gujarat v. Rasikbhai @ Kaushikbhai Havsingbhai Garasiya
items.coram: Ilesh J. Vora, R.T. Vachhani, JJ.
items.headline: DNA report inadmissible unless the expert testifies
items.text: The acquittal in a rape case was upheld. The DNA report could not be relied on as the scientist who ran the test was not examined.

items.caseName: Union of India v. Mohsin Sharieff
items.coram: D.K. Singh, H. Shanthi Bhushan, JJ.
items.headline: 3 acres of Yelahanka defence land restored to IAF
items.text: The Military Land Register is conclusive proof of title. A private claim based on a 2015 sale deed failed.

items.caseName: Santhosh Kumar H.L. v. State of Karnataka
items.headline: Blow to pregnant woman's abdomen can be attempt to murder
items.text: No visible injury and a healthy delivery do not take such an assault outside Section 307 IPC. The plea to quash was rejected.

items.caseName: Juhi v. Union of India
items.headline: No OBC reservation within NRI quota seats
items.text: NRI quota is separate and unreserved, so a NEET-UG candidate cannot claim both NRI and OBC benefits.

items.caseName: Chandan G v. State of Karnataka
items.headline: Rs 2.77 crore for man paralysed by falling tree branch
items.text: BBMP was held liable for a dangerous tree on school land beside a public road and must pay compensation with 6% interest.

items.caseName: X v. Rajesh
items.caseNo: Rev. Pet. Family Court No. 100065 of 2025
items.headline: Master's degree no bar to wife's maintenance
items.text: Denial of permanent alimony earlier does not defeat a Section 125 CrPC claim. The husband must pay Rs 5,000 a month each to wife and child.

items.caseName: X v. Y
items.coram: M.I. Arun, Raghavendra Seetharam Srivatsa, JJ.
items.headline: No Section 65B certificate needed in family courts
items.text: Section 14 of the Family Courts Act overrides the Evidence Act, so electronic evidence can be accepted without a 65B certificate.

items.caseName: Kerala Police Association v. State of Kerala
items.headline: Order abolishing police officers' association quashed
items.text: The order restructuring police associations breached Article 19(1)(c) and was passed without consulting members.

items.caseName: Vipin Pandey v. Rani Durgavati University
items.headline: Bar Council told to frame minimum stipend for juniors
items.text: Guidelines are due within six months. The Court suggested Rs 20,000 a month in cities and Rs 15,000 in rural areas for three years.

items.caseName: Dr. Pushyamitra Mishra v. State of Madhya Pradesh
items.headline: 'An FIR is not an encyclopedia'
items.text: Not spelling out each accused's role is no ground to quash. Disputed facts must go to trial.

items.caseName: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India v. G. Subramania Koushik
items.coram: N. Satish Kumar, Bharatha Chakravarthy, JJ.
items.headline: Micro/nano plastic warning labels stay
items.text: FSSAI's review of the order for warnings on water, salt and sugar packs was rejected. Consumers have a right to know.

items.caseName: S. Kasiramalingam v. Election Commission of India
items.coram: CJ S.A. Dharmadhikari, G. Arul Murugan, J.
items.headline: 'Publicity' PIL on resigned MLAs' poll costs dismissed
items.text: The Court said it cannot order MLAs who resigned to repay election expenses, and imposed Rs 1 lakh costs.

items.caseName: State of Punjab v. Neelam
items.coram: Vinod S. Bhardwaj, Ravinder Malik, JJ.
items.headline: Death sentence for burying toddler alive commuted
items.text: The crime was heinous but not rarest of rare. The sentence became 30 years' rigorous imprisonment without remission.

items.caseName: Jaibir Singh v. Chaudhary Bansi Lal University
items.headline: Interview can't be a 'veto' without minimum marks
items.text: Where no qualifying marks were set for the interview, declaring a candidate unsuitable on it alone was a jurisdictional overreach.

items.caseName: Vinita Pooniya v. State of Rajasthan
items.headline: One absent voter can't stall Khatushyamji civic poll
items.text: A single voter's absence is not a ground to postpone polling or order a re-poll. Schedules must hold barring riots or calamities.

items.caseName: M. Uday Krishna Reddy v. State of Telangana
items.headline: No routine potency test where digital penetration is alleged
items.text: The order for a potency test was set aside, as the prosecution did not show its relevance to the allegations.

items.caseName: Chief Judicial Magistrate v. Najeeb Kanthapuram
items.court: Chief Judicial Magistrate Court, Manjeri, Kerala
items.headline: Contempt notice to MLA for obstructing advocate commissioner
items.text: The CJM issued a show-cause notice to the Perinthalmanna MLA over obstruction of property possession proceedings. Reply due in 7 working days.

items.caseName: Sachin Hindurao Waze v. National Investigation Agency
items.headline: Bail for Sachin Waze in Antilia bomb scare case
items.text: The court found no concrete evidence that terror was created and faulted the NIA for never recording the Ambani family's statements.

items.caseName: Bihar State Ardh Sarkari Arajpati Karamchari Maha Sangh v. State of Bihar
items.headline: Rs 1 lakh each for daily-wagers in 25-year-old Bihar dues case
items.text: Bihar and Jharkhand must pay each daily-wage worker Rs 1 lakh, with 12% interest on delayed PF and 6% on delayed wages. The Court rejected a flat Rs 42.50-a-day rate as unfair.
items.why: Workers not yet traced get 12 months to claim, and verified lists must go online within 4 weeks.

items.caseName: In Re: Recent Rape Incidents in Delhi NCR
items.coram: J.B. Pardiwala, K. Vinod Chandran, JJ.
items.headline: Safety audit of Delhi-NCR public spaces ordered within 4 weeks
items.text: In the suo motu case, police must map vulnerable spots district by district, step up patrols and audit street lighting and CCTV, including at transit hubs. Status reports are due in four weeks.
items.why: The bench described the incidents as a systemic failure of policing and administration.

items.caseName: Owners and Parties Interested in M.V. Nereus Progress v. Om Freight Forwarders Ltd.
items.coram: CJI Surya Kant, Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: Bareboat charter ends on a valid termination notice
items.text: A BARECON 2017 bareboat charter ends once a valid termination notice is served, without repossession; the former charterer then holds the ship only as a bailee. The sister-vessel arrest was vacated.

items.caseName: State of Maharashtra v. Ramesh Sukrya Mhatre
items.headline: Bail of Shiv Sena corporator in doctors' assault case cancelled
items.text: The Court set aside the Bombay High Court's bail order and told Mhatre to surrender within three days. It said a firm message was needed that doctors cannot be attacked.

items.caseName: Puneet Batra v. Union of India
items.headline: Delhi HC ruling upholding GST search of advocate's office stayed
items.text: The Court stayed the High Court judgment and gave the respondents three weeks to reply. The bench asked why the reasons for searching a lawyer's office were not disclosed.

items.caseName: Rubabuddin Shaikh v. Central Bureau of Investigation
items.coram: CJI Surya Kant, Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: Notice on challenge to acquittal of 22 in Sohrabuddin encounter case
items.text: Notice was issued on the appeal against the Bombay High Court's acquittal of 22 accused. The bench called 92 hostile witnesses a serious concern but said the discharge of Amit Shah will not be reopened.

items.caseName: Mamata Banerjee v. Election Commission of India
items.coram: CJI Surya Kant, Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: ECI to decide Trinamool name and symbol dispute within 3 months
items.text: Both sides must file affidavits within four weeks. The Election Commission must then decide the TMC symbol dispute within three months.

items.caseName: Anjan Datta v. Union of India
items.coram: CJI Surya Kant, Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: No stay on MDR charge for UPI payments above Rs 2,000
items.text: The Court declined to stay the merchant discount rate on UPI transactions above Rs 2,000. The Centre must file an affidavit explaining the legal and technical basis for the levy.

items.caseName: Fanindra Das v. The General Manager
items.headline: Electricity is part of the right to life: Railways told to give connection
items.text: Calling electricity indispensable to life under Article 21, the Court quashed the 2011 and 2012 refusals. North Eastern Railway must provide the connection within 30 days.

items.caseName: Indian Secular Front v. Election Commission of India
items.headline: Order reserved on ISF plea over 'Envelope' symbol in Nandigram by-poll
items.text: The judge questioned whether the ECI was guided by a private party in allotting ISF's symbol to the TMC-Democratic faction. The ECI said the plea was meant to derail the poll.

items.caseName: Manoj Chaudhary v. State (NCT of Delhi)
items.headline: Re-arrest needs a magistrate's reasoned permission after a vitiated arrest
items.text: Where an accused is freed because grounds of arrest were not supplied, police need a magistrate's reasoned permission to re-arrest. Re-arrest merely because charges were added was illegal.
items.why: Lays down the procedure after an Article 22(1) violation.

items.caseName: Ms G v. State (NCT of Delhi)
items.headline: Rape survivor must be heard before the accused gets bail
items.text: A victim may take part at every stage, including regular bail hearings. The bail order passed without notice to her was set aside and sent back for a fresh hearing within two weeks.

items.caseName: Ayush Kumar v. National Testing Agency
items.headline: NTA to issue duplicate NEET-UG scorecards to foreign medical graduates
items.text: The Court relaxed document requirements, allowing self-attested affidavits and photographs. Applications are due within 7 days and scorecards within 7 more, ahead of the FMGE.

items.caseName: Janhvi Kapoor v. John Does
items.headline: Amici appointed to settle scope of celebrity personality rights
items.text: The Court picked three suits to decide whether using a celebrity's photo breaches personality rights when the photographer owns the copyright. Gautam Bhatia and Rohan Alva were appointed amici.

items.caseName: Tabinda Nazir v. Union Territory
items.headline: Baramulla fake-decree probe moved to Crime Branch SIT
items.text: The Court transferred the probe into allegedly fabricated judicial records to the Crime Branch and formed an SIT. Advocate Tabinda Nazir was granted interim bail.

items.caseName: Dr. Ashwin Hebbar K. v. State of Karnataka
items.headline: Internal Committee report cannot close a sexual harassment FIR
items.text: An offence under Section 354A IPC is cognizable and needs a police probe, so an Internal Committee's closure does not end it. Delay in filing is a trial defence, not a ground to quash.

items.caseName: Pratap N.M. v. State of Karnataka
items.headline: FIR against YouTuber over sodium-in-water experiment quashed
items.text: Sodium is not an explosive substance and the video showed no malicious intent under the Explosive Substances Act. The FIR was quashed with a caution against repeating such stunts.

items.caseName: In Re Exorbitant Pricing of Life Saving Patented Medicines
items.headline: Centre can use Section 100 Patents Act to supply costly patented drugs
items.text: Section 100 of the Patents Act lets the Centre make and supply patented medicines for non-commercial government use. The Court said this is warranted where life-saving drugs are priced out of reach.
items.why: Opens a route to affordable access to high-priced life-saving medicines.

items.caseName: Muhammed Nihad v. State of Kerala
items.headline: Anticipatory bail for YouTuber 'Thoppi' in obscenity case
items.text: After viewing the video, the Court found no obscene or sexually coloured words spoken by the applicant against the complainant. Custodial interrogation was unnecessary, so bail was granted.

items.caseName: K.R. Periyakaruppan v. R. Seenivasa Sethupathi
items.headline: Challenge to one-vote win in Tirupattur rejected at threshold
items.text: The election petition was rejected for not pleading material facts. Even taken as true, the allegations did not show the result was materially affected.

items.caseName: R v. R
items.headline: Not every clash between wife and in-laws is cruelty
items.text: The Madurai Bench refused the husband a divorce, finding no grave or continuing cruelty. The wife living with her parents while he worked abroad was not desertion.

items.caseName: Women Wrestlers v. Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh
items.court: Rouse Avenue Court, New Delhi, Delhi
items.headline: Notice to Brij Bhushan on wrestlers' appeal against his acquittal
items.text: The court sought responses from Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh and co-accused Vinod Tomar on four women wrestlers' appeal against their acquittal. The matter is next listed on 9 October.

items.caseName: Jai Prakash Singh v. State of Uttar Pradesh & Ors.
items.headline: Senior can't be paid less than junior in same post
items.text: Two lecturers were appointed the same day in 1990 at a college in Aligarh, but the junior drew higher pay after getting advance increments. The Court held the gap had no valid basis and violated the guarantee of equality.
items.why: Pay parity between colleagues holding the same post applies even when increments come through a court order.

items.caseName: Shivendu Pandey v. State of U.P. & 11 Ors.
items.headline: UP told to frame compensation policy after Lucknow fire
items.text: UP has no compensation policy for deaths in incidents other than natural calamities, such as the June 2026 Lucknow fire that killed 15 young people. The State must frame one with clear criteria and pay an injured survivor's medical costs.

items.caseName: Balveer Singh v. State of U.P. & Ors.
items.headline: Senior citizens tribunal can't void gift deed for forgery
items.text: A tribunal under the Senior Citizens Act cannot declare a gift deed void on a claim of forgery. That dispute belongs in a civil court.

items.caseName: Nitin Mishra v. Union of India & 6 Ors.
items.coram: Arindam Sinha & Satya Veer Singh, JJ.
items.headline: Lone NEET-UG answer key objection rejected
items.text: Disputed questions go to an expert only when facts justify it. A single objection, already rejected by the NTA and backed by no other candidate, did not.

items.caseName: Mohammad Jalaluddin v. State of U.P. & 3 Ors.
items.headline: Owner can't plead ignorance to save beef-laden vehicle
items.text: Once the meat is confirmed as beef, the statutory presumption applies to an owner travelling in the vehicle. He failed to rebut it, so the confiscation stands.

items.caseName: M/s. Pharmed Limited v. Union of India
items.coram: Manish Pitale & Shreeram V. Shirsat, JJ.
items.headline: NPPA's blanket drug price ceiling quashed
items.text: A 2009 NPPA notification applied ceiling prices to any formulation containing a scheduled drug. The court quashed it: the DPCO required a formula-based ceiling price notified for each formulation, which was never done.
items.why: Drug price controls must follow the DPCO's product-by-product method.

items.caseName: Aman @ Aman Ibrahim Khan v. The Commissioner of Police, Pune
items.coram: Sarang V. Kotwal & Ranjitsinha Raja Bhonsale, JJ.
items.headline: Detention can't rest on a guess that bail is likely
items.text: A detention order under the Maharashtra MPDA Act was set aside. Saying the detenu would probably get bail, without material to back it, is not a valid ground.

items.caseName: Archana Singh v. Anand Kumar
items.coram: Parth Prateem Sahu & Sushma Sawant, JJ.
items.headline: Unchallenged WhatsApp chats prove cruelty; divorce granted
items.text: Family Courts are not bound by strict rules of evidence. Unchallenged WhatsApp messages showing mental cruelty could be relied on, and the wife was granted divorce.

items.caseName: Praveen Kumar Yadav v. Smt. Priyanka Yadav
items.coram: Parth Prateem Sahu & Sachin Singh Rajput, JJ.
items.headline: Husband's visits don't prove wife left without cause
items.text: Repeated visits to the wife's parental home or a legal notice do not show her refusal to return was unreasonable. Her allegations of ill-treatment and dowry demands justified living apart.

items.caseName: Shahbuddin v. State
items.headline: Rape conviction overturned after 13 years
items.text: The survivor said her clothes were soaked in blood, but forensic tests found none. The court called this a positive contradiction, not a mere lack of corroboration, and set aside the kidnapping and rape conviction.

items.caseName: Union of India & Ors. v. Himanshi & 34 Ors.
items.coram: C. Hari Shankar & Vinod Kumar, JJ.
items.headline: Unfair means must be proved candidate by candidate
items.text: The SSC cancelled candidatures in the 2019 CHSL exam and imposed seven-year debarments. The court found the evidence against the candidate did not hold and ruled a one-size-fits-all approach unlawful.

items.caseName: Equitas Small Finance Bank Ltd. v. Mrs Nirmala Bai Shanthilal & Ors.
items.headline: Bank can't disown its counsel's settlement statement
items.text: The bank's cheque-bounce case was closed after its counsel reported a settlement before the Magistrate and the Lok Adalat. A year later it called that statement unauthorised; the court refused, warning that would cause chaos.

items.caseName: Smt. Simran Kaur v. State (Govt. of NCT of Delhi)
items.headline: Travel refused, but pregnant accused's care protected
items.text: An Afghan national under investigation was not allowed to go to the UK to give birth. Police must ensure the probe does not delay her medical care during her twin pregnancy.

items.caseName: Yeshwant Shenoy v. Bar Council of Kerala
items.headline: Notice on challenge to Bar Council committees
items.text: An elected member says the Chairman announced the statutory committees of the XIII Bar Council of Kerala without holding elections. Notice was issued to the Council and its Chairman; the case returns on 1 October.

items.caseName: Sanjay Kumar Yadav v. State of Bihar & Ors.
items.headline: An FIR alone can't sink an arms licence
items.text: The Collector refused a builder's licence only because a criminal case was pending, in which he was later acquitted. The refusal was quashed: a threat to public safety must be shown.

items.caseName: Navin Kumar v. State of Bihar & Ors.
items.headline: Department's own lapses can't block contractor's dues
items.text: Poor supervision and record-keeping by the department is no ground to withhold payment for completed work. About ₹19.8 lakh in dues and security deposits must be paid with 5% interest.

items.caseName: Heera Mani v. State of Rajasthan & Anr.
items.coram: Sanjay K. Agrawal, CJ & Vinit Kumar Mathur, J.
items.headline: Absence due to long illness is not wilful misconduct
items.text: A constable's absence during prolonged tuberculosis was not deliberate, so his termination was quashed. His widow gets all service and retiral benefits.

items.caseName: Rapti v. State of Uttarakhand & Anr.
items.headline: Stepfather must maintain the child he knowingly accepted
items.text: A man who married knowing of his wife's son from an earlier marriage took on responsibility for the boy. Maintenance was raised, with ₹10,000 a month for the son until he comes of age.

items.caseName: Paramjit Singh Bedi v. State of Punjab
items.coram: Ujjal Bhuyan & Atul S. Chandurkar, JJ.
items.headline: Rape conviction set aside: testimony can't be split
items.text: The Court acquitted the appellant, holding that a court cannot accept part of the prosecutrix's statement and reject the rest. Material gaps in her account meant the conviction could not rest on her word alone.
items.why: A conviction on the victim's sole testimony still needs an account that is reliable as a whole.

items.caseName: Sukhabhai Nanjibhai Makwana & Anr. v. Union of India
items.coram: Ujjal Bhuyan & Atul S. Chandurkar, JJ.
items.headline: Missing train ticket can't defeat a death claim
items.text: Failure to recover a ticket does not defeat a compensation claim when other evidence shows the deceased was a bona fide passenger. The Railway Claims Tribunal's ₹8 lakh award to the parents was restored, payable within 30 days.

items.caseName: Owners and Parties Interested in M.V. Nereus Progress v. Om Freight Forwarders Ltd.
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI, Joymalya Bagchi & V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: Valid charter termination ends it without repossession
items.text: A valid termination of a bareboat charter ends the demise charter even if the owner has not physically taken the ship back. The vessel's arrest was set aside.

items.caseName: Committee of Management, Jami Masjid Sambhal v. Hari Shankar Jain & Ors.
items.headline: Verdict reserved on Sambhal mosque survey
items.text: The mosque committee challenges the Allahabad High Court's approval of a court-appointed commissioner to survey the Sambhal Jama Masjid. The key question is whether the Places of Worship Act bars the suit.

items.caseName: Rimly Gogoi Saikia v. State of Assam & Ors.
items.headline: Assam told to produce GD entries, CCTV in custodial death plea
items.text: The deceased's sister seeks a CBI probe into alleged custodial torture. The Court called for the General Diary entries, CCTV footage and the High Court record, and kept the stay on magisterial proceedings.

items.caseName: Puneet Batra v. Union of India
items.headline: Advocate shielded from GST action till 28 September
items.text: The advocate challenges the Delhi High Court's approval of a GST search of his office and seizure of computers, raising client privilege. No action may be taken against him until the next date, 28 September.

items.caseName: Meeran Haider v. State (Govt. of NCT of Delhi)
items.coram: Aravind Kumar & Vipul M. Pancholi, JJ.
items.headline: Delhi riots accused's reporting condition eased
items.text: Haider now reports once a week, on Saturdays, and is exempted on two dates for his wedding. Curbs on social media, public gatherings and posters stay.

items.caseName: Brahmeshwar Nath Mishra v. Union of India
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI, Joymalya Bagchi & V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: PIL for Hindi as the Supreme Court's language dismissed
items.text: The Court said such a change comes gradually through administrative reform, not court orders. The relief would also need a constitutional amendment.

items.caseName: Shubham Mishra v. Union of India & Ors.
items.coram: Shekhar B. Saraf & Abdhesh Kumar Chaudhary, JJ.
items.headline: Medical boards can't re-quantify certified disability
items.text: Boards may assess only functional competency for medical education, not redo a disability percentage certified under the RPwD Act. The petitioners were held eligible as PwBD candidates for MBBS.

items.caseName: Rahul @ Dharamdev v. State of U.P.
items.headline: DGP probe ordered into seized car used in police raid
items.text: The confiscation challenge failed, but the court ordered a DGP inquiry within 8 weeks into how a seized vehicle left police custody and ended up in a fatal accident.

items.caseName: Naresh Singh v. State of U.P. & Ors.
items.coram: Arindam Sinha & Satya Veer Singh, JJ.
items.headline: No negligence without information to act on
items.text: A police officer's censure over a fatal explosion was quashed. An officer cannot be faulted for not acting when no information calling for action reached him.

items.caseName: Metta Appana v. State of Andhra Pradesh & Ors.
items.headline: Prosecution sanction can't be withdrawn without new material
items.text: Once prosecution under the PC Act has begun, a valid sanction cannot be withdrawn unless fresh material emerges. Restoration of the sanction in a disproportionate assets case was upheld.

items.caseName: State of West Bengal v. Milan Pradhan
items.coram: Division Bench led by R.V. Ghuge, CJ
items.headline: Nandigram by-poll candidate's protection set aside
items.text: The Division Bench set aside a single judge's protection in a 2007 case and told the Congress candidate to apply for bail. A single judge then heard his interim bail plea and reserved orders.

items.caseName: X v. State (NCT of Delhi) & Ors.
items.headline: Takedown of morphed image of woman with PM ordered
items.text: Meta must remove the morphed image within 24 hours, and the woman gets police protection. The accused party leaders were issued notice.

items.caseName: SARR Freights v. Argo Coral Maritime
items.headline: London arbitration in UN cargo dispute halted
items.text: The final booking note had no arbitration clause, and one from earlier talks cannot be read into it. The London arbitration was restrained.

items.caseName: United Forum of Bank Unions Delhi State v. Union of India & Ors.
items.headline: Police to decide bank unions' protest venue by Monday
items.text: Delhi Police must decide the unions' request for a protest site other than Jantar Mantar by 4 PM on Monday.

items.caseName: Arjunbhai Sukhabhai Halpati v. State of Gujarat
items.headline: Bail for father in 'burning wicks' death
items.text: The father applied burning wicks to his daughter, who believed she was possessed, and she died. Finding no intent to kill and a rash act at most, the court granted regular bail.

items.caseName: Directorate of Enforcement v. Md. Saleem Khan & Ors.
items.headline: ED's bid to add charges against Farooq Abdullah rejected
items.text: Charges can be added under Section 216 CrPC only where material prima facie shows the offence. The court refused to add two RPC offences in the JKCA funds case, but they may be added if trial evidence supports them.

items.caseName: The Defence Research (DRDO) v. Special Land Acquisition Officer
items.coram: D.K. Singh & H. Shanthi Bhushan, JJ.
items.headline: DRDO land acquisition upheld on national security
items.text: The bench reversed a single judge and upheld land acquisition for a defence research lab. Skipping the enquiry was justified by urgency and caused landowners no real prejudice.

items.caseName: K.S. Arunkumar v. State of Keralam & Anr.
items.headline: No arrest of CPI(M) leader over Facebook post
items.text: No coercive steps may be taken against Arunkumar over his post on the Home Minister's foreign trip, though the probe can continue. Posted to 6 November.

items.caseName: Javin Ara Rizvi v. Usha Parmar
items.headline: Non-bailable warrant against Panna Collector in contempt
items.text: The Collector neither appeared nor filed a compliance report despite notice, which the court called indifference to the judicial process. She must appear on 30 September.

items.caseName: DY v. GY
items.headline: Article 227 can't be used to quash a conjugal rights suit
items.text: Family Court orders in restitution suits are appealable, so a petition under Article 227 to quash the wife's suit is not maintainable. Claims of harassment must be proved at trial.

items.caseName: Tulir Charitable Trust v. The State
items.headline: Media barred from airing videos in Veeramani POCSO case
items.text: To protect the victims, media and platforms may not publish videos linked to the POCSO case against R. Veeramani. The SIT will issue weekly press releases; next hearing 30 September.

items.caseName: K. Ponmudy v. Assistant Director
items.coram: S.A. Dharmadhikari, CJ & G. Arul Murugan, J.
items.headline: Notice to ED on ex-minister Ponmudy's PMLA quash plea
items.text: Ponmudy relies on his acquittal in the predicate quarry-licence case to seek quashing of the money-laundering case. Notice is returnable in two weeks.

items.caseName: Dr. Ranjana Gupta v. Union of India & Ors.
items.coram: Jasgurpreet Singh Puri & Pravindra Singh Chauhan, JJ.
items.headline: Toll plaza near Fazilka upheld
items.text: The toll plaza about 4.75 km from municipal limits substantially complies with the rules. Halting a nearly complete highway project would not serve justice.

items.caseName: Daljit Kaur & Anr. v. State of Punjab & Ors.
items.headline: No CBI probe on mere claims of police bias
items.text: Transfer to the CBI is an extraordinary remedy. Instead, a DIG-rank IPS officer will supervise the extortion and firing probes, and electronic evidence must be preserved.

items.court: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court IX, Ernakulam, Kerala
items.caseName: Ansiba Hassan v. Lakshmi Priya & Ors.
items.headline: Police probe ordered into remarks against actress
items.text: On actress Ansiba Hassan's complaint, the magistrate directed police to investigate actress Lakshmi Priya and two channel representatives over sexually coloured remarks and videos. The High Court had asked the magistrate to reconsider an earlier dismissal.

highlights.text: Death sentence for the rape-murder of a 6-year-old stepdaughter commuted to life imprisonment.

highlights.text: Telangana MLA Danam Nagender's disqualification for defection upheld.

highlights.caseName: Ajeet Bharti v. State
highlights.text: Anticipatory bail refused to Ajeet Bharti; video prima facie caste-based abuse of MP Chandrashekhar Azad.

highlights.caseName: Annamalai K v. Piyush V
highlights.text: Hate speech case against Annamalai quashed; criminal law is no tool to stifle political dissent.

items.caseName: 'R' v. 'E' & Anr. (and connected matters)
items.headline: Safeguards against misuse of POCSO in custody fights
items.text: Where a parent is accused under POCSO during a matrimonial dispute, there is no automatic arrest on an FIR and a child psychiatrist or psychologist must be consulted first. The Court quashed a mother's FIR against the father, which the CBI found unsupported, and asked the Family Court to oversee the child's return to him.
items.why: Police and courts now have national guardrails for POCSO complaints made in custody battles.

items.caseName: Waris v. State of Madhya Pradesh
items.coram: Vikram Nath, Sandeep Mehta & Vijay Bishnoi, JJ.
items.headline: Death sentence for rape-murder of 6-year-old commuted
items.text: The Court upheld the conviction for the rape and murder of the man's six-year-old stepdaughter. It set aside the death sentence and imposed life imprisonment, finding the case did not meet the test for capital punishment.

items.caseName: Danam Nagender v. Alleti Maheshwar Reddy
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI, Joymalya Bagchi & V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: Telangana MLA's defection disqualification upheld
items.text: The Court dismissed Danam Nagender's appeal against the Telangana High Court ruling disqualifying him as an MLA. He had contested the 2024 Lok Sabha polls on a Congress ticket while still a sitting BRS MLA.

items.caseName: Union of India & Ors. v. Ramdhani Prasad
items.coram: Aravind Kumar & Vipul M. Pancholi, JJ.
items.headline: Article 311 bar does not apply to an officer of equal rank
items.text: Article 311(1) only stops removal by an officer below the appointing authority's rank. An RPSF constable appointed by an Assistant Commandant was validly removed by an Adjutant of equal rank, so his removal was restored.

items.caseName: Naval Kishore & Anr. v. State of Punjab
items.coram: Aravind Kumar & Vipul M. Pancholi, JJ.
items.headline: Sessions courts cannot bar remission in a sentence
items.text: Only the Supreme Court and High Courts can impose a fixed-term or whole-life sentence that excludes remission. The Court replaced a trial court's no-remission life term with 25 years' rigorous imprisonment without remission.

items.caseName: Sri Anumandala Rajesh Reddy v. State of Karnataka & Anr.
items.headline: No sanction needed before a Magistrate orders an FIR
items.text: A Magistrate's direction under Section 156(3) CrPC to register an FIR comes before cognizance, so sanction under Section 197 to prosecute a public servant is not needed at that stage. The investigation, quashed by the High Court, will resume.

items.caseName: Union of India v. Rohith Nathan & Anr.
items.headline: Verdict reserved on making OBC creamy-layer ruling prospective
items.text: The Centre wants the March 2026 ruling, that creamy-layer status cannot rest on parents' salary alone, to leave completed recruitments and admissions untouched. The Court reserved its decision.

items.caseName: Mamata Banerjee v. Election Commission of India
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI, Joymalya Bagchi & V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: ECI told to propose a timeline in the Trinamool symbol dispute
items.text: The Court asked the Election Commission to suggest a timeframe for deciding the rival claims to the AITC name and symbol, fair to both sides but not drawn out. The matter is listed next week.

items.caseName: State of Tamil Nadu v. State of Karnataka
items.coram: Vikram Nath, Sandeep Mehta & Vijay Bishnoi, JJ.
items.headline: Karnataka to answer TN's Cauvery shortfall plea
items.text: Tamil Nadu says Karnataka has under-released Cauvery water by about 16–20 TMC. Karnataka has a week to reply, and the matter is listed in October.

items.caseName: Deepak Singla v. Directorate of Enforcement
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI, Joymalya Bagchi & V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: Notice to ED on AAP leader's bail plea
items.text: Deepak Singla challenges the Punjab & Haryana High Court's 9 September refusal of bail in a money-laundering case. The Court issued notice to the ED.

items.caseName: Sujay Radhakrishna Vikhe-Patil v. Nilesh Dyandev Lanke
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI, Joymalya Bagchi & V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: Notice on challenge to Ahmednagar MP's 2024 win
items.text: The appeal challenges the Bombay High Court's dismissal of an election petition alleging corrupt practices and excess spending. The Court sought MP Nilesh Lanke's reply.

items.caseName: Just Rights for Children Alliance & Anr. v. S. Harish & Ors.
items.coram: J.B. Pardiwala & K. Vinod Chandran, JJ.
items.headline: Last chance to Centre on online child abuse material
items.text: The IT and Law Ministries were given one last chance to report on implementing the 2024 judgment on child sexual abuse material and on safeguards for social media platforms. Next hearing: 15 October.

items.caseName: Periyammal (Dead) through LRs & Ors. v. V. Rajamani & Anr.
items.coram: J.B. Pardiwala & K. Vinod Chandran, JJ.
items.headline: Execution rules for commercial suits should be in the statute
items.text: The Court suggested adding a Schedule of execution rules to the Commercial Courts Act, 2015 to tackle pending execution petitions. It awaits fresh data from the High Courts; next date 7 October.

items.caseName: Siddharth Varadarajan v. State of U.P. & Anr.
items.headline: The Wire editor allowed to travel to the US
items.text: The court let Siddharth Varadarajan travel to New York from 28 September to 7 October. It noted the trial in the 2020 FIRs has not begun and found nothing to suggest he would abscond.

items.caseName: Shahrukh v. State of U.P. (with connected jail appeal)
items.coram: Siddhartha Varma & Jai Krishna Upadhyay, JJ.
items.headline: Call records alone can't place accused with the victim
items.text: The court acquitted a wife and her alleged partner of her husband's murder. Call detail records by themselves do not prove the accused were physically with the deceased, and the chain of circumstances was incomplete.

items.caseName: Ashok Maruti Kanase v. State of Maharashtra
items.headline: Creating a situation that drives suicide can be abetment
items.text: The court upheld a husband's conviction for cruelty and abetting his wife's suicide after harassment over money. Abetment can include creating circumstances that amount to instigation.

items.caseName: Milan Pradhan v. State of West Bengal
items.headline: Nandigram by-poll candidate protected in a 2007 case
items.text: Police may take no further steps against the Congress candidate in a 2007 case until 12 October. The court was surprised the police acted only now, 19 years later, just before the by-poll.

items.caseName: Ishani Datta Ray & Anr. v. State of West Bengal & Ors.
items.headline: No coercive action against ABP journalists over headline FIR
items.text: The court protected an Anandabazar Patrika editor and journalist from coercive action until 15 December over the 'Gerua Gundami' headline, provided they keep cooperating with the probe.

items.caseName: Ajeet Bharti v. State
items.headline: Anticipatory bail refused in SC/ST Act case
items.text: The court found Ajeet Bharti's video prima facie used caste superiority to humiliate MP Chandrashekhar Azad, disclosing offences under the SC/ST Act. That Act bars anticipatory bail.

items.caseName: Dr. Manish Kamra v. Union of India & Ors.
items.headline: Higher education can't be curtailed lightly
items.text: A government doctor was allowed leave for a three-year cardiology super-speciality course. The right to higher education is not a fundamental right, but it cannot be restricted without good reason.

items.caseName: Omar Rashid v. X & Ors.
items.headline: Notice on journalist's plea against anonymous posts
items.text: The court issued notice on journalist Omar Rashid's plea to take down anonymous posts accusing him of sexual harassment. It remarked that serious allegations need corroboration. Listed on 7 October.

items.caseName: S v. Union of India & Ors.
items.headline: Adoptive mother's plea to hand son to CARA
items.text: A widowed adoptive mother seeks to transfer custody of her son to CARA or the Child Welfare Committee, citing behavioural issues. The court sought replies within a week.

items.caseName: Dr. Vikas Divyakirti v. Meta Platforms Inc. & Ors.
items.headline: Drishti IAS founder's personality rights suit
items.text: The suit seeks protection of Vikas Divyakirti's name and likeness, including against fake online profiles. The judge sent it to the bench hearing personality-rights cases.

items.caseName: Arvind Kejriwal v. Gujarat University & Ors.
items.coram: Sunita Agarwal, CJ & D.N. Ray, J.
items.headline: PM degree row: verdict reserved on Kejriwal's cost appeal
items.text: Kejriwal challenges the 2023 order that set aside the CIC's direction to disclose PM Modi's degree and made him pay ₹25,000 costs. The bench reserved judgment.

items.caseName: Imtiyaz Nuruddin Chinchali v. State of Karnataka & Anr.
items.headline: Insulting the PM is not an offence without intent to breach peace
items.text: Rude or abusive words alone do not attract Section 352 BNS without intent to provoke a breach of the peace. The court quashed the case against a shopkeeper.

items.caseName: R v. S
items.coram: D.K. Singh & H. Shanthi Bhushan, JJ.
items.headline: Short marriage alone doesn't fix alimony
items.text: The court upheld ₹50 lakh permanent alimony and dismissed both spouses' appeals. The length of a marriage cannot alone decide the amount.

items.caseName: Adaguru H. Vishwanath v. B.S. Suresha
items.headline: Defamation case against MLC over MUDA remarks continues
items.text: The court refused to quash defamation proceedings over press-conference remarks against a minister. Good faith and harm to reputation are questions for trial.

items.caseName: Yellamma & Ors. v. Ramappa & Ors.
items.headline: Presumption of a joint Hindu family weakens with distance
items.text: Seventy years of separate living rebutted the presumption that two branches of a family were still joint. A common ancestor alone is not enough.

items.caseName: Asma Ghori (Mogare) & Ors. v. State of Karnataka & Ors.
items.headline: Urdu and Marathi teachers' recruitment plea sent back
items.text: The bench sent back linguistic-minority candidates' challenge for a hearing on merits, recording the State's statement that it is considering recruiting Urdu and Marathi teachers.

items.caseName: Raeesa Parveen v. Union of India & Ors.
items.headline: No court decree needed to remove ex-husband's name from passport
items.text: Talaq is a valid divorce under Muslim personal law and the passport rules do not require a decree. The passport office must process the reissue without one.

items.caseName: Tomin J. Thachankary v. State of Kerala
items.headline: Verdict reserved on ex-DGP's plea to suspend sentence
items.text: The former DGP seeks suspension of his four-year sentence for disproportionate assets. The judge remarked that PC Act convicts are too easily released pending appeal, and reserved orders.

items.caseName: Annamalai K v. Piyush V
items.headline: Hate speech case against Annamalai quashed
items.text: Nothing showed intent to promote enmity in Annamalai's remarks about Muthuramalinga Thevar. The court warned against using criminal law to stifle political dissent.

items.caseName: V v. A
items.headline: 'If there are housewives, there can be house husbands'
items.text: The court dissolved an irretrievably broken marriage on the husband's offer of ₹2.5 crore for his wife and children. It observed that husbands taking up homemaking should become normal.

items.caseName: K. Suthan v. Union of India & Ors.
items.coram: S.A. Dharmadhikari, CJ & G. Arul Murugan, J.
items.headline: 'We cannot legislate': bye-poll cost PIL dismissed
items.text: The court dismissed a PIL seeking to recover bye-election costs from MLAs who resign soon after winning. Such a rule is for the legislature, not the courts.

items.caseName: State of Punjab v. Union of India & Ors.
items.headline: Punjab withdraws habeas plea after ED raid ends
items.text: After the ED search ended and the officials were freed, Punjab withdrew its habeas corpus plea with liberty to go to the proper forum. The State must pay the warrant officer's ₹55,000 fee.

items.court: Principal District & Sessions Court, Gandhinagar, Gujarat
items.caseName: Ravi Nair v. Government of Gujarat & Anr.
items.coram: Ashish J.S. Malhotra, Principal District & Sessions Judge
items.headline: Journalist Ravi Nair granted bail in Adani defamation case
items.text: The sessions court granted Ravi Nair regular bail. He had been arrested on a non-bailable warrant after missing a hearing in his appeal in the Adani defamation case.

items.caseName: Chhagan Chandrakant Bhujbal v. State of Maharashtra
items.headline: Chhagan Bhujbal discharged in Central Library case
items.text: The special court found no ground to proceed against the minister in the Kalina Central Library corruption case. Criminal liability needs proof of the accused's own participation, not 'invisible support'.
